classification: ASSUMED deployment and volume; published reference unit prices, not an invoice or CloudStack quote
region_assumption: Reference DigitalOcean Basic Regular public IaaS pricing; regional availability/taxes must be confirmed before purchase

published_price_extracts.vm: Basic Regular: 2 vCPU, 4 GiB RAM, 80 GiB SSD, 4000 GiB transfer: USD 24/month
published_price_extracts.load_balancer: Regional pricing starts at USD 12 per month
published_price_extracts.object_storage: USD 5/month: 250 GiB storage and 1 TiB outbound transfer; excess USD 0.02/GiB storage and USD 0.01/GiB transfer
published_price_extracts.llm: Groq openai/gpt-oss-20b: USD 0.075 input / USD 0.30 output per 1M tokens. Llama 3.1 8B currently Contact Sales, so its old price is not reused.

compute.role: worker nodes: backend + Keycloak + format worker + monitoring

llm.status: Projection only; no LLM integration or paid API call in this evidence
llm.token_note: All token counts are assumptions. Output budget includes reasoning tokens; actual model usage may exceed it. Quality, latency and retries remain untested.

exclusions: Tax, exchange rate, domain, labor, support, local laptop depreciation/electricity and cloud overages
Managed PostgreSQL (the model uses a self-managed VM, not a managed service)
HA control plane, database standby and Keycloak HA
CloudStack physical hosts, management/system VMs, licenses where applicable, and shared-infrastructure cost allocation
Cloud migration and object-storage adapter implementation cost
